info.title: GATEWAY-batchinsertion-List Fitness Memberships Guestpass-v1-spec
info.description: The Fitness Membership Guest Pass API provides access to a comprehensive list of available guest passes associated with fitness memberships. This API enables fitness centers and service providers to retrieve detailed information about guest pass offerings, including eligibility, duration, and restrictions. Typical consumers include fitness center staff and third-party applications that facilitate membership management or promotional campaigns. By utilizing this API, organizations can enhance their customer engagement and streamline guest pass transactions.

get.description: This endpoint allows you to fetch detailed information regarding the guest pass memberships available. It includes data such as eligibility criteria, duration, and benefits associated with the guest pass.

requestBody.description: Request body for retrieving guest pass information for memberships. This body is required to provide the necessary parameters and data needed for the request.

ListFitnessMembershipsGuestpassRequest.description: This schema represents the request body for the GET operation related to guest pass memberships.

status.description: Indicates whether the operation was successful.

referenceNumber.description: The reference number associated with the guest pass operation.

resultId.description: The unique identifier for the result of the operation.

state.description: The current state of the guest pass operation.

processingTimeMs.description: The time taken to process the operation in milliseconds.

message.description: A message providing additional information about the operation.

audit.description: Contains audit information related to the operation.

ListFitnessMembershipsGuestpassResponse_.description: Response schema for the guest pass operation GET request, indicating the status and details of the processing.

createdBy.description: Identifier of the user or system that created the audit entry.

createdAt.description: Timestamp indicating when the audit entry was created.

automated.description: Indicator of whether the operation was automated.

Audit.description: Details about the audit process of the guest pass operation.

x-processing-time.description: The amount of time, in milliseconds, that the server spent processing the request. A value of 0 indicates that the processing was instantaneous.
